property_summary: Every call to newGrantProposal increases c.proposalCount() by exactly 1 (the new proposal's id is the previous count plus one); the mutant increments by 2, so for some inputs the count after one call differs.
change_summary: Replace `proposalCount += 1;` with `proposalCount += 2;` so each grant proposal advances the counter by two instead of one.
